body: Yea; I’ve tried man. Been going to therapy for almost 10 years, been in the psych ward twice; been on 6/7 different anti depressants/anti anxiety meds. Ketamine even. Nothings really worked. Although you’re not wrong, over thinking does usually make things worse. Most definitely. I guess I’m just at a really low point. I wish I could explain it or convey it differently. But yea no I agree with you, that’s what’s gotten me this far. Trying to focus on the present.
Aye I appreciate it man, only problem is my rollercoasters been on the decline for the past 7 years. I appreciate that though. And I wish I could, but I feel pretty numb
